evidence.quote: Peng He [email protected] Research summary: We develop computational methods and construct high-resolution single-cell and spatial maps of human tissues and organoids across development, disease and experimental perturbations. https://peng-he-lab.github.io/

research.text: We develop computational methods that leverage foundation models and machine learning to address fundamental challenges in single-cell and spatial genomics. Current efforts include building more precise data integration frameworks to overcome batch effects, improving cross-study and cross-species atlas construction, and developing automated analysis systems for single-cell RNA-seq and chromatin accessibility datasets.

research.text: I joined the Yang Lab as a visiting master’s thesis student, pursuing a degree in the Neuroscience program at the University of Tubingen in Germany. I studied Molecular Biology and Genetics as an undergraduate at Bilkent University in Turkey and discovered my passion for neuroscience during my internship in neuroendocrinology at the University of Cambridge. Throughout my research experiences, I’ve worked on various neurodegenerative diseases, and I’m particularly interested in developing therapies for these conditions. Outside the lab, I enjoy reading, painting, traveling, spending time with my pets, and analog photography.
